Definition: from G4253 and G2064 (including its alternate); to go onward, precede (in place or time):--go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.
BiblicalUsage: Proerchomai means to go onward, to precede, to go before. Jesus goes a little farther in Gethsemane and falls on his face, and the angel says John shall go before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that going before is the forerunner's work, and John went before so that Jesus could be seen.
